day_cards.title: D1 · OLD CORE
day_cards.zh: 南门与城墙 → 碑林或书院门 → 钟鼓楼
day_cards.ja: 南門と城壁 → 碑林または書院門 → 鐘鼓楼
day_cards.en:
WALL → BEILIN OR SHUYUANMEN
→ TOWERS + LANES

day_cards.title: D2 · QIN ARCHAEOLOGY
day_cards.zh: 按预约去临潼 → 三坑按序看 → 留住返程
day_cards.ja: 予約に合わせ臨潼へ → 三坑を順に → 帰路を確保
day_cards.en:
BOOKED ENTRY → THREE PITS IN ORDER
→ PROTECT THE RETURN

day_cards.title: D3 · MUSEUM + PAGODA
day_cards.zh: 一座博物馆 → 午休 → 一座塔；预约失败就替换
day_cards.ja: 博物館一館 → 昼休み → 塔一基。予約不可なら差替え
day_cards.en:
ONE MUSEUM → REST → ONE PAGODA
USE THE SMALL-PAGODA FALLBACK

day_cards.title: D4 · ONE NEARBY PLACE
day_cards.zh: 四选一；按天气、体力与返程决定
day_cards.ja: 四か所から一つ。天候、体力、帰路で決める
day_cards.en:
CHOOSE ONE NEARBY PLACE
WEATHER + ENERGY + RETURN

day_cards.title: D5 · DEPTH + RECOVERY
day_cards.zh: 补回一处，或走一条新主线；不再远郊
day_cards.ja: 一か所へ戻るか、新しい一本線へ。遠出は重ねない
day_cards.en:
ONE MISSED PLACE OR ONE NEW THREAD
NO SECOND EXCURSION

visual_qa.notes: Inspected at the 7000 x 5040 master, a 2079-pixel B6 landscape proof, and a 900-pixel mobile zoom proof matching the website's enlarged map view. The nested 2/3/5-day rule, five day cards, urban sequence, Day 2 Qin anchor, and four mutually exclusive Day 4 choices remain distinct; no line is presented as navigation or a current transport promise.
